verdict.rationale: Abacum places budgets and live ERP actuals in one model, which implies budget-vs-actuals comparison. It normalizes charts of accounts, and it describes P&L numbers as 'traceable when they question them', which hints at drill-down. None of this explicitly documents a variance report, a department-level cut, or drilling into the transactions behind a variance. Missing for 10: explicit budget-vs-actuals variance reporting, department and account breakdowns, documented transaction-level drill-down from a variance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
